pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.description:
InvocationInDoubt fires when the invocation that the state started is
 in doubt: its last lease ended with no result (decisions 0199 and 0200).
 A state that starts an agent run or an external action declares it; a
 check in doubt runs again, so a state that starts one does not.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.title: Invocation In Doubt

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.description:
InvocationResult fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.title: Invocation Result

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.description:
StateEntered fires as the state is entered, for a state that only
 decides.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.title: State Entered

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.description:
Trigger is what fires a transition (decision 0170): exactly one of these.
 The kernel reads triggers from Subscribe in log order, and each event
 fires at most once.

^(in_doubt)$.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

event.description:
An event whose subject is the plan, by its CloudEvents type, such as
 "dev.getpumi.approval.recorded" (decision 0135).

inDoubt.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

result.description: The result of the state's invocation.

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.title: Trigger
